notes.title: Year-End Recap & Important Updates For Our Snowcastle Community
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello there, Adventurers! 🌱[/h1][/b]

[b]As we approach the end of the year, it's time to reflect on the milestones we've achieved together and share some important updates.[/b]

[h2][b]🎉 Ikonei Island Launched on Steam and Epic[/b][/h2]

We're thrilled to announce the successful launch of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550730/Ikonei_Island_An_Earthlock_Adventure/]Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure[/url][/b] on November 9th, now available on both Steam and Epic platforms. We worked hard to implement the “Friends’ Pass”, which also functions as a demo! The [b]“[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1550730/discussions/0/3948028800075910873/]Friends’ Pass[/url]”[/b] allows a group of up to 4 players to play indefinitely on the host’s island, provided the host owns the game. We hope this fosters a sense of community and collaboration among players. 

We are not done with Ikonei Island yet - [b]On December 14th, Ikonei is celebrating “Lystide”!
Players will be visited by “The Spirit of Lystide Past” - so make sure to check out the Hamlet![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/a169e38a74f42c826116f329d5bceb46bdcf3c7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/06cbfd70ed93f37d1bf4d5f12b679ce47a271211.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/5649d99f731ff81f3590bc70725da6e6e051ef74.png[/img]
[i]Lystide sneak peeks![/i]
[hr][/hr]
Your support has been instrumental in making this launch a success, and we're excited to continue building and expanding Ikonei Island in the coming months.

[h2][b]🌱 Earthlock's Epic Store Free Week[/b][/h2]

Our first title, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/761030/EARTHLOCK/]Earthlock[/url][/b], was originally released in 2018. We have seen a huge boost in activity since it was available for free on the Epic Store for a week in November. Over 5.9 million people claimed the game! We hope you enjoyed revisiting the world of Earthlock. Be sure to check out our comics on Steam and Epic if you want to delve further into the Earthlock lore.

[h2][b]🏜️ Earthlock 2 Delay and Updates[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/edf30162d71cd0e1985c189d0cacde7ca2245b16.png[/img]

We have restarted the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/826640/EARTHLOCK_2/]Earthlock 2[/url][/b] project and with that put the date to TBA. For the last year, we have been in pre-production totally redesigning the main concept and direction of the game. We are super excited to share this new vision for E2 with you and will be doing so in the upcoming months.

Our team made the choice to switch from Unity to Unreal Engine a couple of years ago. This has been a huge undertaking, and we have learned a lot about the engine, and the way we work as a studio. Another major challenge we have taken on is working on our first multiplayer game in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550730/Ikonei_Island_An_Earthlock_Adventure/]Ikonei Island[/url]. We have grown as a studio tackling these challenges, but it has cost us more time than initially anticipated.

However, for the last year, we have gone back to pre-production working on the core vision, and redesigned the main concept for the game. We feel we have something really good now, and we have been presenting this to publishers and investors lately. [b][url=https://twitter.com/snowcastlegames/status/1730559440892342606]We even won an award for the most anticipated game at an investor event in Malta at the end of November.[/url][/b] 

We are working on making this vision presentable to the community and will begin posting about this soon. We’re excited to share these new features and more news about the development process going forward, so [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/826640/EARTHLOCK_2/]wishlist Earthlock 2 to keep up to date![/url][/b]

Speaking of new features… What’s this? 

[previewyoutube=p-7ranLvh98;full][/previewyoutube]

As we wrap up the year, we want to express our gratitude for your unwavering support, feedback, and enthusiasm. Our community plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of our games, and we look forward to embarking on new adventures together in the upcoming year. 

Wishing you a joyful holiday season and a fantastic New Year filled with exciting gaming experiences!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]💙 Join Our Discord Island[/b][/h2]

Join our community on [b][url=https://discord.gg/snowcastlegames]Discord[/url][/b]! We've got contests, and channels where you can share feedback, report bugs, get help with the game, and find friends to play with. Aside from the magnanimous presence of your favorite Frogboy!

And please consider wishlisting Earthlock 2! It's the best way you can support Snowcastle and our next project right now (updates + adjusted release date coming to the page soon) ♥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826640/EARTHLOCK_2/


We'll see you at the Lystide event! Check out the central area of Ikonei Island on December 14th 🎄
[i][b]Snowcastle Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch: Credit where credit is due + Announcing 2nd comic!
notes.content:
We just released a patch to enable the credits from the main menu. 

There is  a lot of people who deserve credit for the game - among them the backers. Having to play the game to the very end to see the credits is a bit unfair for those that just like to see their name in the credits.

[b]New Comic[/b]
We are happy to announce that we have began making a new comic book. Below is a little sneak peak.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31520203/9e38d729c8cc85049f2aedd6718a148c470f9da0.png[/img]

Oh, and btw Earthlock is on 40% sale right now. Even better deal with the bundle!

Best regards,
Snowcastle Team

notes.title: EARTHLOCK now live in 12 languages!
notes.content:
[h1]We are happy to announce that we have published the language patch.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31520203/7d972f4ef906f1824e6e8585aa972d42cd66bad0.png[/img]

Since we don't speak all languages, we are dependent on our community to let us know if the translators have done a good job. 

[b]A warm thank you to all those who tested the language beta and gave us feedback![/b]

Please post comments about localisations in the corresponding [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/761030/discussions/0/1693795812289664964/]discussion thread[/url].

This was a massive job and we are super excited to get your feedback! 

Best regards,
Snowcastle Team

notes.title: Celebrating the launch of EARTHLOCK with a sale!
notes.content:
[h1](Steam, PS4, XboxOne, Switch)[/h1]

We have spent 15 months extending, improving and polishing EARTHLOCK. Now the game has become what we always wanted it to be, and both user reviews and the press seem to agree! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31520203/88168b07430b94f4ff93205a0425f63cb244d1ef.jpg[/img]

I have written a blogpost about developing the extended version [url=https://medium.com/@bendikstang/how-we-changed-the-review-score-from-mid-60s-to-80-and-was-it-worth-it-3630ccaac279]here[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31520203/8c908320608f81ad881db00d05f621b0e9c026f4.png[/img]

If you have not played Earthlock yet, or only played a little of the start, now is a good time to give it a spin! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31520203/895df48a5ff6f32ecad38a42264c0d8167b512f8.png[/img]

Here is a list of English editorial reviews:[code]
-------------------------------------------------------
[b]Average: 					80%[/b]
-------------------------------------------------------
[url=http://thezarf.com/earthlock-review/]TheZarf[/url]				100%
[url=https://xboxtavern.com/earthlock-review/]PS4blog[/url]				90%
[url=]XboxTavern[/url]			90%
[url=http://monstervine.com/2018/03/earthlock-review-a-second-chance/]Monstervine[/url]			90%
[url=https://www.bonusstage.co.uk/2018/03/08/earthlock-review/]BonusStage[/url]			90%
[url=https://www.mmorpg.com/earthlock-festival-of-magic/reviews/a-classic-rpg-finally-on-the-switch-1000000457]MMORPG[/url]				85%
[url=http://www.ps3blog.net/2018/04/12/beyond-playstation-earthlock-review/]PS3blog[/url]			85%
[url=http://cogconnected.com/review/earthlock-extended-edition-review/]CogConnected[/url] 			85%
[url=https://www.goombastomp.com/115195-2/]Goombastomp[/url] 		80%
[url=https://www.gamingboulevard.com/2018/05/earthlock/]Gamingboulevard[/url]		80%
[url=https://www.meups4.com.br/analises/earthlock-vale-a-pena/]Meups4[/url]			80%
[url=http://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/switch-eshop/earthlock]Nintendolife[/url]		80%
[url=http://gamingtrend.com/feature/reviews/a-festival-of-turn-based-rpg-goodness-earthlock-review/]Gamingtrend[/url]			80%
[url=https://switchscore.net/earthlock-review/]Switchscore[/url]			80%
[url=https://miketendo64.com/2018/03/08/review-earthlock-nintendo-switch/]Miketendo64[/url]			80%
-------------------------------------------------------[/code]

[H1]Localizations almost complete![/h1]
We are really close to adding [b]9 new languages![/b] We will publish a localization beta early next week and invite anyone to check out the new languages. 

Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Spanish, Italian, German, French and Arabic.

As soon as we have checked that the translations are good, we will publish the official language patch to Steam.

[h1]Demo has been released[/h1]
If you like to try before you buy then we have just published the thing for you. 
The demo is approximately an hour or so of the game and should give a fair sense of what it is. 

Best regards,
Snowcastle Team

notes.title: Patch today (Bug fixes)
notes.content:
A new patch is up addressing the following bugs:

1. Benjo’s Quest: Bug where players could get stuck.
2. Fixed a bug in the Goblin mine where you could get teleported by accident.
3. Missing text in the Japanese tutorials.
4. Fixed issues with playing the game in 4K.

Thank you to all the players that have given us valuable feedback so we could fix these bugs!

We're listening and reading all the bugs and reviews that are coming in.
Even though the Extended Edition is completed and "out there", we're still interested in receiving feedback, [b]reviews[/b] and comments, so please don't be shy! The more the better! :-)

notes.title: Linux Beta is live!
notes.content:
[h1]The linux beta has just been added.[/h1] 

To access it, please right click on EARTHLOCK in the library and choose Properties. Then choose the Beta tab and type in the code:

[b]LinuxTesting[/b]

Once you have verified the code the linuxtesting branch should be available for download.

We have a general feedback thread in the forum and a special bug thread in the bug forum. 

Looking forward to the feedback ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Launch time!
notes.content:
[h1]Languages[/h1] 
EARTHLOCK will launch in English and Japanese first, the rest will be patched in as soon as possible. We are in the process of getting it translated to all the following languages. Here is the list:

[list]
[*]English (Default) 
[*]Japanese (Default) 
[*]Norwegian (Completed - done in house TBA) 
[*]German (TBA)
[*]French (TBA) 
[*]Spanish (TBA)
[*]Italian (TBA) 
[*]Polish (TBA) 
[*]Arabic (TBA)
[*]Chinese (Complete re-translation TBA) 
[*]Russian ([b]New[/b] TBA) 
[*]Brazilian Portuguese ([b]New[/b] TBA)
[/list]

[H1]DLCs[/h1]
We will be adding 2 DLCs in the next few days. 
[list]
[*]Sound Track
[*]In-Game Comic Book 
[/list]

[h1] First review [/h1]
The first review of the new version just came in (Switch version):

“[i]...Earthlock is a game that simply demands to be played! 
...Bravo Snowcastle Games, you’ve made a charming game, a positively outstanding one! [/i]”

Read the rest of the very thorough review from Miketendo 64 [url=https://miketendo64.com/2018/03/08/review-earthlock-nintendo-switch/]here[/url]
